description: In-line method invocation - the ISO 8.4.3.1.2 Format 4 identifier, `{object-class-name-1 | identifier-1} :: literal-1 [ ( arguments ) ]` (8.4.3.4.2), reachable from every operand position that admits a function-identifier (the Format-1 twin: 8.4.3.2.3 SR1 and 8.4.3.4.3 SR1 exclude both from a RECEIVING operand in the same words, so no receiving rule admits either - InlineMethodInvocationOperandDriftTests pins that invariant over the .g4 text). Gated at 2002 with the rest of the OO CORE; THE EDGE IS DERIVED, NOT QUOTED (the VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE discipline - the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text): (a) A.4.10 lists exactly three OPTIONAL object-orientation elements - CLASS-ID INHERITS repetition, INTERFACE-ID INHERITS repetition, parametric polymorphism - and inline method invocation is NOT among them, so it is mandatory OO surface, which this compiler gates at 2002 throughout, (b) Annex E itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does not list it, so it predates 2023, (c) 8.4.3.4.4 GR1 defines it as the equivalent INVOKE statement, itself a 2002 introduction. Below 2002 the VersionConformancePass parse arm names the edition on RECOGNITION (VisitInlineMethodInvocation -> 0900), which the superseded inline-method-invocation-2023 row could not do: that row described `id(args)` - a shape ISO defines nowhere, carrying no distinctive token - while the real construct is led by the 8.7.4 invocation operator '::' (kb/Work PB428).
vcr: 2002 introduction (OO; derived - A.4.10 optional-list silence + Annex E silence + 8.4.3.4.4 GR1)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. IMI.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS IMIC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 OBJ USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE IMIC.
01 W PIC X(2).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE IMIC "NEW" RETURNING OBJ.
    MOVE OBJ :: "GETIT" TO W.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM IMI.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. IMIC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
METHOD-ID. GETIT.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 LK PIC X(2).
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING LK.
MAIN.
    MOVE "OK" TO LK.
END METHOD GETIT.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS IMIC.
